title: Scrum Master - C
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


The Scrum Master ensures that the Scrum teamâs primary focus is on delivering value effectively. To achieve this, the team embodies the Agile values and principles, exhibits Agile behaviors and follows the events, artifacts, roles and good practices of Scrum and other frameworks as they are applicable to their situation. They are a Servant Leader, guiding, coaching and teaching team members. They are a liaison between the Scrum team and people or teams outside the Scrum team.Â With their experience, they are accountable for a Scrum teamâs effectiveness, by helping them remove impediments or blockers within the team, other teams, and across the organization.Â They support the Product Owner, sharing techniques to define the product goal and better manage the product backlog. Their coaching helps the Product Owner to establish an empirical process for product planning. They are conversant in the purpose and the logic of the product/service, its architecture, and the technologies that the team uses.As a change agent, they are responsible to lead the organization in implementing Scrum through training, coaching, and advising. A primary focus here is helping the organization adopt an empirical approach.Â They facilitate interactions between stakeholders and the Scrum team to foster openness, respect, and learning.As with any leading role, Scrum Masters are representatives of Capgemini. By nurturing Agile processes and delivery efficiency, they also ensure the discovery of new business opportunities together with the client.
**Job Description \- Grade Specific**
-------------------------------------


Senior Scrum Master â A Senior Scrum Master is a Scrum master who can handle more complex delivery circumstances, e.g. during an Agile Transformation. They can handle multiple teams, and exhibit Lean\-Agile leadership in a scaled environment. They remove team delivery blockers and enhance Agile Mindset and Behaviours. They support teams by introducing them to applicable practices of Scrum and other frameworks like XP, Kanban. They contribute to the growth of the Scrum Master community, mentoring new SMs. They support learning and development by running knowledge sharing sessions.
**Skills (competencies)**
-------------------------

description:

**Job Purpose**
---------------



The primary objective of this role is to support the successful delivery of enterprise AI initiatives by contributing to both platform engineering and application development. The candidate will help maintain reliable cloud environments, support AI projects throughout their lifecycle, and contribute to the continuous enhancement of enterprise AI applications that enable internal teams and external vendors to build and deploy Agentic AI solutions.


The candidate will contribute to both enterprise AI platform engineering and full\-stack application development by working closely with project stakeholders and technical teams. They will assist in provisioning cloud infrastructure, maintaining enterprise environments, supporting CI/CD processes, resolving infrastructure and application issues, and enhancing the observability of the enterprise Agentic AI platform. They will also contribute to the development and maintenance of enterprise AI web applications by implementing new features, developing APIs and supporting ongoing enhancements.


The IT Engineer – Agentic AI Platform Engineer reports to an IT Team Lead or Domain Lead depending on the Agile or DevOps organizational structure. The position collaborates closely with External Consultants and Vendors, Project Managers and Scrum Masters, IT Business Partners, Enterprise and Solution Architects, Global Process Owners/Global Process Design Leads, Process Coaches, and cross\-functional technology and business teams. The role has no direct or indirect reports but may coordinate contributors and delivery activities within enterprise AI programs and projects.

**Key Activities**
------------------


* Collaborate with project stakeholders and technical teams to understand infrastructure and application requirements for AI projects.
* Assist in provisioning, configuring and maintaining cloud infrastructure and development environments for enterprise AI solutions.
* Support enterprise server environments through routine maintenance, security patching and environment management.
* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, access management and application\-related issues.
* Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
* Monitor the operational health of the enterprise Agentic AI platform and support improvements in observability and platform reliability.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of enterprise AI web applications using React.js, Node.js and Express.js.
* Build and enhance REST APIs and integrate applications with AI services and enterprise systems.
* Participate in testing, deployments, production support and technical documentation.
**Experience**
--------------


* Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Professional experience ranges from 0–1 years for entry\-level engineering profiles through 6\+ years for advanced engineering and leadership\-oriented levels depending on MM1–MM3 maturity classification.
* Hands\-on experience with React.js, Node.js and Express.js.
* Good understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs and backend application development.
* Familiarity with Git and version control.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure. Exposure to AWS or Google Cloud Platform is also acceptable.
* Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking and access management concepts.
* Exposure to CI/CD concepts and deployment workflows.
* Exposure to Linux or Windows server environments.
* Basic knowledge of Python is an advantage for automation and AI\-related integrations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and business teams.

description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Position Summary:**


We are seeking a Senior AI Transformation Lead to drive the adoption and integration of Artificial Intelligence across our software engineering organization. This role will lead the transformation of how our teams design, develop, test, deploy, and operate a cloud\-based oncology SaaS platform deployed on AWS and used by cancer patients, clinicians, and healthcare providers worldwide.

  

The successful candidate will partner with Engineering, Product, Quality Assurance, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and Leadership teams to implement AI\-enabled software development practices, improve engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance software quality, and establish AI governance in a regulated medical device environment.


This is a strategic and hands\-on leadership role requiring deep understanding of modern software engineering, AI technologies, developer productivity, quality engineering, and organizational change management.


The product is Siemens Healthineers´s cloud\-based software solution for patient relationships and care navigation management. It’s designed to connect cancer patients with their clinics online throughout the entire cancer journey. The product used by 35 000\+ active cancer patients and healthcare professionals from leading oncology centers in North America and Europe. The candidate in this role will provide strong product development leadership to a team of software engineers and test engineers, working in an agile/scrum environment.

* Define and execute the AI transformation roadmap for the software engineering organization.
* Define KPIs and success metrics to measure AI adoption and business impact.
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted development tools and workflows across engineering teams.
* Enable developers to leverage AI for coding, code reviews, documentation, debugging, refactoring, architecture design, and knowledge sharing.
* Integrate AI capabilities into the development lifecycle for Java, Kotlin, Python, Spring Boot, Angular, and mobile application development.
* Lead adoption of AI\-powered testing and quality engineering practices.
* Drive AI\-assisted test generation, regression analysis, defect prediction, and release risk assessment.
* Drive AI adoption across CI/CD, deployment automation, monitoring, incident management, and operational workflows.
* Implement AI\-assisted root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and operational intelligence.
* Evaluate and implement AI platforms, frameworks, and tooling.
* Partner with Architects and Engineering teams to define scalable AI integration patterns.
* Support development of internal AI assistants and engineering productivity solutions

  

**Work Experience**  

**Qualifications Required:** BE, MSc, MCA, Computer Science or related discipline.

**Number of year’s related experience:** 8\-12 years

**Special Knowledge / Skills:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field.
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3 years driving AI, engineering productivity, developer experience, or technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and AI\-assisted software development tools.
* Hands\-on experience with software technologies such as Java, Kotlin, Python, Spring Boot, Angular, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Experience working with AWS cloud environments and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, vector databases, RAG architectures, MCP, AI agents, and prompt engineering.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience leading AI transformation initiatives in large software engineering organizations.
* Experience developing healthcare products conforming quality system regulations.
* Experience in healthcare domain and medical interoperability standards such as FHIR, HL7
* Certifications from AWS or Azure

The **Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Product Owner / Business Data Analyst** bridges business strategy and technical execution across Citi's data and analytics ecosystem. * **Data Modeling (Tableau \& SQL):** Build and maintain data models, semantic layers, and relationships (joins, blending, LOD calculations) to support multi\-dimensional reporting.
* **SQL Data Analysis:** Write complex SQL queries (joins, CTEs, subqueries, analytical/window functions) across relational and enterprise data warehouses to extract, validate, and analyze datasets.
* **Dashboarding \& Report Visualization:** Design, build, and optimize interactive, production\-ready dashboards in **Tableau** (or PowerBI) to visualize financial, operational, performance, and risk metrics.
* **Business Process Analysis:** Translate business workflows, transaction flows, and financial reporting requirements (e.g., P\&L, balance sheet trends) into clear data and functional specifications.

**3\. Data Governance, Risk \& Controls**


* **Governance Standards:** Apply Citi's Data Management Standard, define Critical Data Elements (CDEs), and establish data quality validation rules.
* **Lineage \& Traceability:** Maintain data lineage, metadata definitions, and data dictionaries to ensure transparency.
* **Risk \& Audit Readiness:** Ensure all project documentation, change controls, and SDLC artifacts comply with Citi’s internal risk and audit standards.

**4\. Stakeholder Collaboration \& Adoption**


* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate with business partners, finance leaders, and risk teams to gather requirements, communicate sprint progress, and manage feedback.
* **User Enablement \& Training:** Prepare user guides, conduct demo sessions, and support change management to drive adoption of analytics solutions.
  

  

**Qualifications \& Competencies**

  

  

**Education \& Experience**

  

  

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Data Analytics, or related field.
* **Experience:**7\+ years in agile product ownership, business analysis, or data analytics within financial services.
  

  

**Technical \& Analytical Skills**

  

  

* **Tableau:** Strong hands\-on proficiency in Tableau Desktop and Server (data modeling, LOD calculations, dashboard creation, performance optimization).
* **SQL \& Databases:** Strong SQL skills with experience querying relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) or cloud/enterprise data platforms.
* **Data Visualization \& Modeling:** Demonstrated ability to build intuitive reports and robust data models from disparate data sources.
* **Agile \& Tools:** Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for user story mapping, backlog management, and documentation.
* **Data Governance:** Working knowledge of data governance principles, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality controls.
  

  

**Soft Skills**

* **Analytical Mindset:** Proactive, structured approach to data analysis and problem resolution.

In this role, you will analyse business requirements, participate in grooming and estimation, design and execute test strategies, identify automation opportunities, build and maintain automation scripts, and help improve product quality based on defect trends and testing outcomes.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Analyse business requirements and actively participate in requirement grooming and estimation.
* Work closely with product owners, developers, quality engineers, and cross\-functional teams to understand features and define effective test coverage.
* Develop test strategies, create test plans, and execute test cases for new features, enhancements, and production support scenarios.
* Identify manual test cases that are suitable for automation and develop automation scripts using Playwright, Selenium, and other automation tools.
* Build, maintain, innovate, and continuously improve automation frameworks, test processes, and quality engineering practices.
* Automate testing across UI, API, batch, and mobile channels to improve regression efficiency and product confidence.
* Perform API testing for SOAP and REST services using tools such as SOAP UI and Postman.
* Validate applications through functional, regression, accessibility, mobile, and microservices testing.
* Write, implement, maintain, and review automation scripts and test artifacts.
* Use SQL to construct moderate to complex queries for validating data and troubleshooting issues.
* Participate in Agile development methodologies and sprint ceremonies, including planning, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Track, analyse, and manage defects while recommending quality improvements based on defect patterns and root causes.
* Collaborate across geographies and teams to support delivery, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
**What You Bring**

* Strong hands\-on testing experience with a focus on automating web and API tests.
* Experience in UI automation testing, API testing, and automation script development and maintenance.
* Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright and Katalon.
* Expertise in automation testing across UI, API, batch, and mobile applications.
* Experience developing or contributing to automation frameworks for enterprise applications.
* Experience on scripting languages such as Python, Ruby, Groovy, Shell, Perl, or similar.
* Strong understanding of manual testing concepts, test scenario design, test case writing, test artifact review, and defect management.
* Experience testing SOAP or REST APIs using SOAP UI, Postman, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with accessibility testing tools and practices such as JAWS and Level Access.
* Experience in mobile testing and web\-based application testing.
* Ability to write moderate to complex SQL queries for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of SDLC, defect management processes, and engineering tools such as Jira, Maven, Git, SOAP UI, Silk Central, BrowserStack, WinSCP, and Putty.
* Ability to troubleshoot basic to complex technical issues and contribute to root cause analysis.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
